map.输入闭环增益与信号频率，计算所需增益带宽积(GBP)并推荐运放: Enter the closed-loop gain and signal frequency to compute the required gain-bandwidth product (GBP) and recommend an op-amp.
map.📖 查看「运放增益带宽设计 使用指南」: 📖 View the op-amp gain bandwidth design usage guide
map.增益带宽积 GBP = 闭环增益 × 信号频率；选型所需 GBP = 目标增益: Gain-bandwidth product GBP = closed-loop gain × signal frequency; the GBP needed for selection is target gain × highest signal frequency, with a 2 to 5 times margin reserved (a 1 MHz signal at gain 100 needs GBW of at least 100 MHz, so choose a 200 MHz or better part); closed-loop bandwidth = GBW ÷ closed-loop gain. When the required GBP is below 10⁶ an LM358 works, from 10⁶ to 10⁷ choose an NE5532 or TL072, and above 10⁷ a high-speed op-amp is required.
map.💡 所需 GBP = 增益 × 频率；建议选型裕量 ≥ 计算值 × 2；−3dB: 💡 Required GBP = gain × frequency; allow a selection margin ≥ the calculated value × 2; the −3dB bandwidth = GBP ÷ gain
map.GBP为运放增益带宽积，数据手册核心参数: GBP is the op-amp gain-bandwidth product, a core datasheet parameter
map.实际选型应留2~10倍裕量: Real selection should leave a 2 to 10 times margin
map.高频信号还需关注压摆率SR: High-frequency signals also require attention to slew rate SR
map.📚 深度解析：运放增益带宽设计: 📚 In-depth analysis: op-amp gain bandwidth design
map.低频信号放大：100Hz × 1000 倍增益选 GBP≥100kHz 通用运放: Low-frequency signal amplification: 100 Hz × gain 1000 calls for GBP ≥ 100 kHz, a general-purpose op-amp.
map.音频放大：20kHz × 10 倍增益选 GBP≥200kHz、低噪声运放。: Audio amplification: 20 kHz × gain 10 calls for GBP ≥ 200 kHz and a low-noise op-amp.
map.高速 ADC 缓冲：1MHz × 1 倍需 GBP≥1MHz 宽带运放。: High-speed ADC buffering: 1 MHz × gain 1 calls for GBP ≥ 1 MHz, a wideband op-amp.
map.视频放大：5MHz × 6 倍选 GBP≥30MHz 视频运放。: Video amplification: 5 MHz × gain 6 calls for GBP ≥ 30 MHz, a video op-amp.
map.GBP=10·100kHz=1MHz；推荐 OPA227（GBP=1MHz 低噪: GBP = 10 · 100 kHz = 1 MHz; an OPA227 (GBP = 1 MHz, low noise) or an LM358 (GBP = 1 MHz, general purpose) is recommended.
map.GBP 与压摆率关系？: How do GBP and slew rate relate?
map.GBP 决定小信号带宽；压摆率 SR 决定大信号压摆；两者共同决定运放可用带宽。: GBP sets the small-signal bandwidth while the slew rate SR sets large-signal slewing; together they determine the usable bandwidth of the op-amp. map.增益带宽积为何是常数？: Why is the gain-bandwidth product a constant?
map.由运放内部晶体管特征频率 fT 决定，fT=Aol·fAol-3dB；闭环增益越: It is set by the transistor transition frequency fT inside the op-amp, with fT = Aol·fAol-3dB. The higher the closed-loop gain, the narrower the usable bandwidth. map.关于「运放增益带宽设计」: About the Op-amp gain bandwidth design
